canonical.behaviour: Release the approval-hook fixes as workflow-axa 2.11.1, so colleagues can update the plugin and see a new version. The fixes are already on origin/main (6d86d70). The version moves from 2.11.0 to 2.11.1 wherever it is stated: .claude-plugin/plugin.json, the README title, UPGRADE.md, skills/rule-maker/rules/version.json, the report renderer's version and the four behavioural case files. CHANGELOG.md gets a 2.11.1 entry and UPGRADE.md a short section (no migration; hooks changed, so restart sessions after updating). VALIDATION.md is regenerated from a full test run. First the local main is put back on origin/main with git reset --soft, keeping its two extra record lines staged, because the local commit was amended after a copy was pushed and can't be pushed without force. Then one release commit and a push to origin main.
exclusions: any change to hooks, skills text or tests beyond the version strings
reinstalling the Codex copies, the local plugin or any global settings
conditions: approving this offer is the owner's OK for tools/verification_summary.py --run --write
git reset only as `git reset --soft origin/main`; nothing in the working tree is discarded
the push is a fast-forward of origin/main; if origin/main moves again, stop and report
checks: git log origin/main shows the release commit after the push
python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" (through verification_summary.py --run --write)
